t: This is Phillimore Gardens, a street in Kensington, West London. It's where Winifred de Bathe died in 1943. She was a member of the British nobility, born in the 1860s, so she lived into her seventies, and her life spanned the Victorian age through to the Second World War. The material I have doesn't say more about her or her time on this street, so I'll keep it simple: a noblewoman's story ended here.
